CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  January 11, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

ITEM 1:
MINUTES: December 9, 2021
Note that the minutes included a typo for the name Daninger and will be corrected.

ITEMS 2-6:
808 Main Street
1600 Elm Street
1720 South Atlantic Boulevard
117 Lanewood Avenue
1301 West Valley Boulevard

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the consent agenda as submitted.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried 3-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
 DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 7:
APPLICANT: 26 South Fremont Avenue

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval.

The designer was present.

Daninger stated that the roof was busy but was acceptable.

Hernandez stated that the design was palatable but that it is unrealistic that all materials are to
match existing. The garage door definition and the doors are not clearly specified. Consideration
to improving the colors and materials should be made.
Udani stated that the drawings and the materials board are not consistent. He also concurred with
Daninger that the roof was busy but acceptable.
Hernandez stated that a color rendering and/or accurate drawings were necessary. Catalogue cuts
to specify all doors and windows should be included.
The designer stated that the materials and colors will match existing. He also stated that he would
prepare a materials board for the planning department. This question was also posed through a
translator.

MOTION:
  •  Hernandez moved to continue the application as submitted.
  •  The second was by Daninger.
  •  The motion carried 3-0 with the following roll call vote:

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Michael Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:00
 •  Seconded by Nora Hernandez
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 8th day of March, 2022.
